name: montuno
description: Montuno: monorepo con la API (NestJS), los contratos Soroban y, más adelante, el frontend. Stellar Testnet.

scripts.build: npm run build -w packages/shared && npm run build -w apps/api && npm run build -w apps/web
scripts.dev: npm run build -w packages/shared && npm run start:dev -w apps/api
scripts.test: npm run build -w packages/shared && npm test -w packages/shared && npm test -w apps/api && npm test -w apps/web
scripts.lint: npm run lint -w apps/api && npm run lint -w packages/shared && npm run lint -w apps/web
scripts.e2e:testnet: npm run build -w packages/shared && npm run e2e:testnet -w apps/api
